mapper.select: SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_company_id AS company_id , apr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , dcr01_print_fund_yn AS print_fund_yn , apr01_title AS title , apr01_inout_cd AS in_out_type_code , apr01_content AS content , apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , apr01_status_cd AS status_code , apr01_reg_emp_id AS reg_emp_id , emp01_kor_nm AS reg_emp_name , apr01_stamp_id AS stamp_id , apr10_stamp_nm AS stamp_name , apr01_stamp_position AS stamp_position , f_cdnm('StampLocation', COALESCE(apr01_stamp_position, '1'), apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS stamp_position_name , apr01_receive_nm AS receive_name , apr01_reference_nm AS reference_name , apr01_sign_company AS sign_company , apr01_sign_ceo AS sign_ceo , apr01_note AS note , apr01_link_cd AS link_code , dcr01_advert_yn AS advert_yn FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = apr01_reg_emp_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans t2 ON ( emp03_person_id = apr01_reg_emp_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = apr01_reg_emp_id AND emp03_trans_date <= apr01_reg_date ) ) INNER JOIN org01_code ON org01_code_id = emp03_org_code_id INNER JOIN org02_info ON ( org02_code_id = org01_code_id AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info WHERE org02_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org02_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date ) ) INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON dcr01_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr10_stamp_id = apr01_stamp_id WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr01_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT apr04_appr_step_id AS appr_step_id , apr04_seq AS seq , apr04_step_type_cd AS step_type_code , f_cdnm('AprStepTypeCode', apr04_step_type_cd, emp01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS step_type_name , apr04_step_status_cd AS step_status_code , f_cdnm('AprStepStatusCode', apr04_step_status_cd, emp01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS step_status_name , apr04_appr_date AS appr_date , apr04_step_emp_id AS step_emp_id , apr04_appr_emp_id AS appr_emp_id , apr04_note AS note , apr04_reject_reason AS reject_reason , CASE WHEN char_length(apr04_note::text) > 0 THEN '의견' WHEN char_length(apr04_reject_reason::text) > 0 THEN '의견' ELSE '' END AS opinion_yn_str , CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apr92_appr_modi WHERE apr92_appr_id = apr04_appr_id AND apr92_reg_emp_id = apr04_step_emp_id ) > 0 THEN '수정' ELSE '' END AS typo_yn_str , emp03_org_code_id AS org_code_id , f_get_empTrans(emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS title_name , emp01_kor_nm AS kor_name , f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, emp03_trans_date) AS org_title_name FROM apr04_appr_step INNER JOIN emp01_person t1 ON emp01_person_id = apr04_step_emp_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans t2 ON ( emp03_person_id = apr04_step_emp_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = apr04_step_emp_id AND emp03_trans_date <= COALESCE(apr04_appr_date, f_today()) ) ) WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} ORDER BY f_to_number(apr04_seq), apr04_step_type_cd, apr04_appr_step_id

SELECT f_get_empTrans(emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS title_name , emp01_kor_nm AS kor_name , f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, emp03_trans_date) AS org_name FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_person_id = #{empId} AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = #{empId} AND emp03_trans_date::date <= CAST(#{baseDate} AS date) ) LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apr07_alt_appr WHERE apr07_target_emp_id = #{personId} AND f_today() BETWEEN apr07_start_date AND apr07_close_date
mapper.sql: apr07_alt_emp_id AS alt_emp_id , apr07_stamp_yn AS stamp_yn , f_get_empTrans(tgt.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'title_nm') AS target_title_name , tgt.emp01_kor_nm AS target_emp_name , f_get_empTrans(tgt.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'org_code_nm') AS target_org_name , f_get_empTrans(org.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'title_nm') AS alt_title_name , org.emp01_kor_nm AS alt_emp_name , f_get_empTrans(org.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'org_code_nm') AS alt_org_name
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM apr07_alt_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person tgt ON tgt.emp01_person_id = apr07_target_emp_id INNER JOIN emp01_person org ON org.emp01_person_id = apr07_alt_emp_id WHERE apr07_target_emp_id = #{personId} AND f_today() BETWEEN apr07_start_date AND apr07_close_date LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
, CAST(f_get_empTrans(org.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'org_code_id') AS NUMERIC) AS alt_org_id FROM apr07_alt_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person tgt ON tgt.emp01_person_id = apr07_target_emp_id INNER JOIN emp01_person org ON org.emp01_person_id = apr07_alt_emp_id WHERE apr07_target_emp_id = #{personId} AND f_today() BETWEEN apr07_start_date AND apr07_close_date ) t WHERE alt_org_id = #{orgId} LIMIT 1

SELECT apr03_relate_fund_id AS relate_fund_id , f_cdnm('IcamFundType', fnd02.fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd, fnd01.fnd01_company_id, fnd02.fnd02_work_date) AS fund_type_name , COALESCE(fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_cd, fnd01.fnd01_fund_cd) AS fund_code , COALESCE(fnd02_r.fnd02_fund_nm, fnd02.fnd02_fund_nm) AS fund_name , apr03_after_yn AS after_yn , apr03_print_yn AS print_yn FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN apr03_relate_fund ON apr03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01 ON fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info fnd02 ON ( fnd02.fnd02_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id AND fnd02.fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info x WHERE x.fnd02_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id AND x.fnd02_work_date <= apr01_reg_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01_r ON fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd02_fund_info fnd02_r ON ( fnd02_r.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id AND fnd02_r.fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info x WHERE x.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id AND x.fnd02_work_date <= f_today() ) ) WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId} ORDER BY apr03_relate_fund_id

SELECT a.apr12_relate_adv_id AS relate_adv_id , b.adv02_manage_cd AS manage_code , b.adv02_manage_nm AS manage_name FROM apr12_relate_adv a INNER JOIN adv02_account b ON a.apr12_adv_id = b.adv02_account_id WHERE apr12_appr_id = #{apprId} ORDER BY a.apr12_relate_adv_id

SELECT a.apr21_relate_appr_id AS relate_appr_id , a.apr21_targer_appr_id AS target_appr_id , b.apr01_inout_cd AS in_out_type_code , CASE WHEN b.apr01_inout_cd = '10' THEN '대외' ELSE '사내' END AS in_out_type_name , b.apr01_reg_date AS target_reg_date , b.apr01_title AS target_title FROM apr21_relate_appr a INNER JOIN apr01_appr b ON a.apr21_targer_appr_id = b.apr01_appr_id WHERE apr21_appr_id = #{apprId} ORDER BY a.apr21_relate_appr_id

SELECT a.apr20_relate_ics_id AS relate_id , a.apr20_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_ics_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.ics01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cycle_name , a.apr20_close_date AS close_date FROM apr20_relate_ics a INNER JOIN ics01_class_tree b ON a.apr20_class_tree_id = b.ics01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON c.sch03_deadline_id = a.apr20_deadline_id AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') WHERE apr20_appr_id = #{apprId} ORDER BY a.apr20_relate_ics_id

SELECT a.apr22_relate_icr_id AS relate_id , a.apr22_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_icr_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.icr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cycle_name , a.apr22_close_date AS close_date FROM apr22_relate_icr a INNER JOIN icr01_class_tree b ON a.apr22_class_tree_id = b.icr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON c.sch03_deadline_id = a.apr22_deadline_id AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('6','7') WHERE apr22_appr_id = #{apprId} ORDER BY a.apr22_relate_icr_id

SELECT apr16_stamp_doc_id AS stamp_doc_id , f_cdnm('CorpDocStampApplType', apr16_appl_type, apr16_company_id, f_today()) AS appl_type_name , CASE WHEN apr16_appl_type = '2' THEN COALESCE(apr15_corp_nm, sys01_company_nm) ELSE apr10_stamp_nm END AS stamp_repr_corp_name , CASE WHEN apr16_appl_type = '3' THEN apr16_stamp_qty ELSE apr16_doc_appl_qty END AS appl_qty , apr16_stamp_out_yn AS stamp_out_yn FROM apr16_stamp_doc LEFT JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr10_stamp_id = apr16_stamp_id LEFT JOIN apr15_repr_corp ON apr15_repr_corp_id = apr16_repr_corp_id LEFT JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = apr16_repr_corp_id WHERE apr16_appr_id = #{apprId} ORDER BY apr16_appl_type, apr16_stamp_doc_id

SELECT file.sys10_file_id AS file_id , file.sys10_file_nm AS file_name , file.sys10_file_ext AS file_ext , file.sys10_file_yn AS file_yn , file.sys10_print_yn AS print_yn FROM ( SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{apprId} UNION SELECT sys10_file.* FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys11_file_id WHERE sys11_parent_id = #{apprId} ) AS file WHERE COALESCE(file.sys10_title_yn, 'false') <> 'true' ORDER BY COALESCE(file.sys10_file_yn, 'false') ASC , LPAD(COALESCE(file.sys10_seq, '99999'), 5, '0') , COALESCE(file.sys10_title_yn, 'false') DESC , file.sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr41_open_history SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{apprId}, f_sysdate(), 'P'
